corrections.text: The article says "PC Gamer's account of Malus relies on a conference presentation." PC Gamer refers only to "their presentation (via The PrimeTime)" and does not say where or at what kind of event it was given.

The article describes Modular's AI clause through the announcement's sentence "You can't use any part of MAX as input to an AI system to produce a reimplementation of MAX." The MAX License text (section 1.4(d)) is broader: "You shall not use MAX, or any portion of it, as training data, fine-tuning data, or input to any AI system in order to produce software that reimplements or substitutes for MAX, whether or not it contains literal copies of MAX." It binds licensees who agree to the license terms.
